objective: Measure whether an INDEPENDENT verification loop (harness-executed checks fed back as structured failures) buys correctness or faster convergence - for a scaffolded agent and for a bare agent given the same feedback. Prompt-scaffolding ablations are settled: 6 fixtures / 17 calls showed no correctness lift and 4-10.7x token cost (see modes.json measurement_basis).

arms.isolates: what a competent engineer sets up WITHOUT this environment: repo instructions (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) pointing at the house conventions plus an explicit run-the-tests-before-done rule. It gets the KNOWLEDGE and the iterate-to-green instruction; it does NOT get harness-EXECUTED frozen checks or a gate that re-runs them itself. This is the arm that decides whether the environment is worth anything: if the loop cannot beat it, the value was 'someone wrote good checks', not our machinery, and we say so.
the loop itself: bare agent + the same independent check feedback, no scaffold
schema-4 standard scaffold (ledger, router, gate, frozen check suite) run single-pass
scaffold plus iteration: does the scaffold converge faster than bare given identical feedback

the DEPLOYABLE mechanical suite: guards derived from the BEFORE-state alone (pinned streams of the surface the ticket says must not change). Available at task time in any real repo; protects against regressions without a mind writing predicates; CANNOT force the new behaviour, by construction - and the measurement says so out loud.

the machinery CEILING: predicates derived from the target diff (the fix's own observable behaviour). NOT deployable - at task time the fix does not exist - so this arm never claims real-world value; it measures whether the loop machinery delivers when predicates are perfect. If even this arm fails to force 100, the bottleneck is the loop, not the predicates.

trial_policy.rationale: ~16pt same-arm run-to-run variance measured on medi-ny-parser-rework-v1 (vanilla scored 73 and 89 across runs); a single trial cannot detect a mode-sized effect and must never be reported as a verdict

loop_arm_policy.feedback: structured failures from the harness-run check suite, returned verbatim and identically to scaffolded and bare loop arms
loop_arm_policy.no_progress_rule: an iteration whose failure fingerprint equals the previous one ends the trial early (no-progress)
loop_arm_policy.call_accounting: every iteration is a provider call and counts toward campaign ceilings; planned ceilings reserve max_iterations_per_trial per loop-arm trial
primary_metrics: silent_errors_en_route (regressions caught by checks the agent never self-reported)

experiments.model_policy: same provider, resolved model and effort across all arms and iterations
experiments.purpose: falsifiable pair of predictions: (a) if the bare loop arm converges as fast as the scaffolded loop arm, the loop is the whole lift and scaffolding stays cost/governance-only; (b) if neither loop arm beats single-pass, the loop is a guardrail (regression catcher), not an accelerator
experiments.verdict_rule: verdicts require min_trials_per_arm_for_verdict; report per-arm score distributions, never single numbers

canary_policy.applies_when: the fixture has no prior paid run whose Evals/runs run-record.json shows outcome_valid=true

first_stage.approval: separate explicit approval for exactly one call

main_stage_requires.note: floor/ceiling collapse (a single reported dimension) blocks the remaining arms; the canary validates the fixture and is NOT counted as a trial

canary_policy.admission_gate: every campaign additionally requires a fresh Fixture Admission Gate record (candidate fixtures) or fresh eval-validity PASS (contracted fixtures)

quality_rule: Prefer the cheapest arm whose score distribution is not worse than the best arm's by more than 3 points median with no additional critical failure.
promotion_rule: A policy boundary changes only after replicated evidence on at least two task families at min_trials_per_arm_for_verdict. Screening never promotes Stable.
cost_controls: every loop iteration counted as a provider call
subscription USD reported as unavailable when the CLI does not expose it
